session: Source links, freshness warnings and past editions
text: `codeyam-editor editor wait-for push` (a command name, not a task output path) was accepted and polled for the full 540s budget with 'no heartbeat yet', even though the real push had finished in seconds under a different task id. It should have refused an unknown target straight away.
mechanism: wait-for accepts a nonexistent target and polls it to the budget

session: Source links, freshness warnings and past editions
text: Loading a finished race's past dates from the database has no test that runs against a real database; the logic it calls is unit-tested.

Verification reported tsc as passing earlier in the cycle, but the pre-commit hook's tsc then failed on the new untracked test file prisma/raceData.test.ts (number | null passed where number was expected). A one-line fix at the commit step meant reopening the build loop with `editor change` and re-running the full session-finalize.
mechanism: type check misses a new untracked file until commit

text: The audit's SCENARIO_FIXTURE_DATE_DRIFT fix suggested replacing absolute seed dates with @today+N tokens. With no pinned clock, @today expanded against the wall-clock day in ET (still Nov 5 at 02:00 UTC), so the Brooklyn price-rise date rendered as Dec 16 instead of Dec 17 and the checked date as Nov 5. I had to switch to the audit's other option and pin a frozen clock on three scenarios.
mechanism: relative seed date tokens anchor to the wall-clock day

session: "Changed since you saved" now works for older saved races
text: Reconcile: audit flagged 62 dependency-stale screenshots for a change with no visual effect. `recapture-stale --skip-when-clean --prefer-touched` captured a 20-of-59 sample (all pixel-identical) and marked 39 fresh-by-sample. `session-finalize` then failed Phase 3.5 demanding `recapture-stale --sweep-sampled`, so a second ~2 min capture pass and a `session-finalize --start-from-phase 2` re-run were needed before Commit.
mechanism: sampled recapture defers a sweep that finalize then refuses

text: `codeyam-editor editor wait-for b4ajfuyxs` was given a task id that did not exist (the push task was b3vezpiyn). It did not reject the id. It polled the full 540s budget, reported 'wrapped command still running (no heartbeat yet)', and exited 75, while the real push had finished in about 7s.
